extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The value f(x) approaches as x approaches a

extracted_concepts.name: One-sided limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Limit from left or right

extracted_concepts.name: Limit at infinity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Behavior of f(x) as x approaches positive or negative infinity

extracted_concepts.name: Squeeze Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If g(x) ≤ f(x) ≤ h(x) and lim g = lim h = L, then lim f = L

extracted_concepts.name: Continuity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function is continuous at a if lim_{x→a} f(x) = f(a)

extracted_concepts.name: Average rate of change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Change in y over change in x

extracted_concepts.name: Instantaneous rate of change
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rate of change at a point

extracted_concepts.name: Derivative
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f'(a) = lim_{h→0} [f(a+h) - f(a)]/h

extracted_concepts.name: Tangent line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Line touching a curve with slope equal to the derivative at the point

extracted_concepts.name: Power Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx(x^n) = nx^(n-1)

extracted_concepts.name: Product Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: (fg)' = f'g + fg'

extracted_concepts.name: Implicit Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Differentiating equations not solved for y

extracted_concepts.name: Inverse Function Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If y = f(x) and x = g(y), then g'(y) = 1/f'(g(y))

extracted_concepts.name: Related Rates
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If two quantities change with time, relate their rates

extracted_concepts.name: Linearization
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: L(x) = f(a) + f'(a)(x-a)

extracted_concepts.name: L'Hospital's Rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: For 0/0 or ∞/∞: lim f/g = lim f'/g'

extracted_concepts.name: Extreme Value Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A continuous function on [a,b] has an absolute max and min

extracted_concepts.name: Critical Point
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Where f'(c) = 0 or f'(c) is undefined

extracted_concepts.name: First Derivative Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Classify critical points using sign changes of f'

extracted_concepts.name: Second Derivative Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: If f'(c)=0 and f''(c)>0 then local minimum

extracted_concepts.name: Concavity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f'' > 0 means concave up, f'' < 0 means concave down

extracted_concepts.name: Optimization
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Find maximum or minimum subject to constraints

extracted_concepts.name: Riemann Sum
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Approximate area using left, right, or midpoint sums

extracted_concepts.name: Definite Integral
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ∫_a^b f(x)dx = lim Σ f(x_i*)Δx

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: d/dx ∫_a^x f(t)dt = f(x); ∫_a^b f(x)dx = F(b)-F(a)

extracted_concepts.name: Substitution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Chain rule in reverse for integrals

extracted_concepts.name: Differential Equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equation involving derivatives

extracted_concepts.name: Slope Field
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Visual representation of dy/dx

extracted_concepts.name: Separation of Variables
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: ∫g(y)dy = ∫f(x)dx

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Model
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: dy/dt = ky implies y = Ce^(kt)

extracted_concepts.name: Average Value of a Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f_avg = (1/(b-a)) ∫_a^b f(x)dx

extracted_concepts.name: Volume of Revolution
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Disc, washer, and shell methods for solids of revolution

extracted_concepts.name: Parametric Equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: x = f(t), y = g(t), dy/dx = g'(t)/f'(t)

extracted_concepts.name: Polar Coordinates
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Area in polar form A = ½∫r²dθ

extracted_concepts.name: Taylor Polynomial
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: P_n(x) = Σ f^(k)(a)(x-a)^k/k!

extracted_concepts.name: Ratio Test
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: L = lim |a_{n+1}/a_n|, converges if L < 1
